$comment: What each behaviour flag REQUIRES, and what settles it.
The chain is adjective -> idiom -> behaviour -> required affordances ->
measurement, and every link but the last is data. This file is the third
link. The flags themselves already existed on the idioms in this
directory and nothing consumed them; this is what reads them.
TWO KINDS OF ANSWER, AND MOST BEHAVIOURS GIVE THE SECOND ONE.
A `requires` entry is a fault that can be proved by READING the patch. An
empty `requires` is not an oversight: it is the statement that this
behaviour cannot be settled without hearing it, and that a static check
claiming to settle it would be inventing a verdict. Only three of these
eight are readable, because only three are carried by param VALUES --
the rest are properties of the sound, and a check that guessed at them
would reject correct patches, which is worse than the gap it filled.
`any_of` IS ORDERED. The first word any module in the patch carries is
the one the patch is judged on; the rest are fallbacks for a patch that
holds nothing of the earlier kind. ['structure', 'pitch'] therefore
means: judge a melody on whatever holds the notes, and only reach for
pitch knobs when the patch has nothing that does. Read as an unordered
set instead, it told a patch with a dual oscillator to detune its two
frequencies against each other -- a chord, confidently offered as a
melody.
`must` is one of:
vary     at least two DISTINCT written values among the params
carrying this affordance on one module. Only modules with two
or more such params can satisfy it, and only those are asked:
a single knob cannot vary, and demanding it would be a
requirement no patch could ever meet.
nonzero  a module's params carrying this affordance are not ALL
written to exactly zero. Every one of them, because four
zeroed rows of an eight-row attenuverter are four unused
channels and a working patch. Fires ONLY on values the patch
wrote itself; an unwritten param sits at its default, and a
default nobody measured is not evidence of anything. Scoped
to affordances that are
AMOUNTS ('how much something wanders', 'how likely'), where
zero means none by definition. Never applied to pitch, timbre
or time, where zero is a position on a scale.
`listen` names the measurement that settles the behaviour and the first
cut at its predicate. It is READ by the gate lane, not by this file's
checks. THE NUMBERS ARE GUESSES. They were written from what a melody or
a rhythm plausibly is, not from patches anybody has heard, and they are
here so the measured gate has one place to disagree with rather than
eight scattered constants. Tighten them against judged patches; do not
treat the first values as law.

requires.remedy: Every step therefore sits at the same voltage and plays as one held note. Write the melody into those values and make them differ from each other.

rhythmic.means: events land in a pattern in time

keeps_going.means: it is still playing at the end

spectrally_varying.means: the colour moves while it plays

requires.remedy: the amount of modulation is set to zero, so nothing moves; raise it

varies_timing.means: the gaps between events are not all the same

requires.remedy: the amount that would make the timing wander is set to zero, so every event lands on the grid; raise it

unmetered.means: there is no steady pulse to find
